claim: Switch Layer 2, tilemap and sprites off on every non-play (ULA-drawn) screen; find every path that leaves play, including ones that never reach the figure plotter.

evidence.text: The high-score check (92E8) turns Layer 2 and sprites off.
Pause menu draws in the ULA and Layer 2 and sprites covered it; stub e_mnu writes NEXTREG 0x15,0 and 0x69,0 around the menu call and restores both on return (checked in MAME).
The hook at 9019 on return to gameplay stops Copper and hides all replacement layers.
Death, continue, round end and game over go through alt-ROM stubs that write NextReg $15 = 0 before the original call; the next commit sets it back to 1.

Layers hidden at a new room, title, game over, giving up, and the LEVEL COMPLETE message (D42B); without the D42B hide figures stayed over the message, and giving up in pause left the overlay over the title until FD75 was hidden too.
